title: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. translated_title: GeoFix：面向4D一致性生成的几何修复
translated_abstract: 视频扩散模型日益被用作4D生成的先验，但其生成的视频往往缺乏几何一致性。近期的方法通过后训练设计几何奖励来解决这一问题，然而这可能会损害纹理和细节表现，因而需要引入辅助的外观奖励并谨慎地平衡各项奖励。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了GeoFix——一个统一框架，它仅通过单一的几何奖励即可同时提升几何一致性和视觉质量，且既适用于训练阶段，也适用于推理时的奖励对齐。我们的奖励通过测量静态场景区域的跨视角深度一致性，专门针对结构性不一致问题，而不会直接约束外观或惩罚有效的物体运动。至关重要的是，我们发现在真实视频和4D数据集中，深度一致性会随相机视场重叠度的增加而自然提高，这导致较小的相机运动可能被误判为更好的几何质量。我们通过校准的方式对该效应进行了修正。
tldr: GeoFix提出仅需单一几何奖励的统一框架，通过测量静态场景区域的跨视角深度一致性并校正视场重叠带来的偏差，在训练和推理阶段同时提升4D生成的几何一致性与视觉质量，避免了传统方法需要多重奖励平衡的弊端。
en_tdlr: GeoFix is a unified framework that improves both geometric consistency and visual quality in 4D generation using a single geometric reward—cross-view depth consistency in static regions with calibration for field-of-view overlap—applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment.
